title: The signed-out public Space page sits in a centred Frequency frame with the member header unchanged, the body on the members ground, and a key-facts column: follow or book, where and hours, contact, and what is coming up

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: the public space pages are highly broken; check what we had in the last design and redesign these to our new theme.

detail: Signed out, /spaces/<slug> and its tabs rendered the Frequency Space chrome straight into the public site shell, which has no column: the cover ran edge to edge, the first tab was cut at the screen edge, the body sat on the Commons sand and there was no right column (the DAWN page had a centred three-column frame). FqSpaceChrome's public mode now opens the site kit's centred .wrap on the members ground the signed-in page reads on, keeps the cover card, identity and tab row exactly as the member page draws them, and sets the body beside an aside (FqSpaceFacts): a Follow card with the Space's own primary action (the header CTA, Book by default) and the join link, Visit (address under the owner's location precision via spaceSchemaLocation, and hours), Contact (phone, email, website, socials) and Coming up (the next three published events, linking to their public pages, plus the Calendar tab). The share root passes it from app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/page.tsx and the signed-out tabs from the (profile) layout when there is no viewer; a signed-in member is unchanged. The facts come from lib/spaces/public-facts.ts, which reads preferences purely and events through the service-role listEventsForSpace, so the share root stays ISR with no cookie client, cookies() or headers().

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];const pg=r('app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/page.tsx');const ly=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/(profile)/layout.tsx');const ch=r('components/frequency/members/space/space-chrome.tsx');const css=r('app/themes/frequency/space-page.css');const fx=r('lib/spaces/public-facts.ts');if(!pg.includes('<FqSpaceFacts'))bad.push('share root has no key-facts column');if(!ly.includes('public={signedOut}')||!ly.includes('<FqSpaceFacts'))bad.push('signed-out tabs not framed');if(!ch.includes('wrap fqs-wrap')||!ch.includes('fqs-cols'))bad.push('chrome opens no container');if(!css.includes('.fqs-cols{display:grid')||css.includes('fqs-public{background:transparent}'))bad.push('no two-column frame on the members ground');if(!fx)bad.push('public-facts missing');if(/supabase.server|cookies[(]|headers[(]/.test(fx))bad.push('facts reader touches the request');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-883: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
